sloka: कुम्भकर्णं समीक्ष्यैव हरयो ऽद्य प्रविद्रुताः ।कथमेनं रणे क्रुद्धं वारयिष्यन्ति वानराः ।। ६.६१.३२ ॥
transliteration: kumbhakarṇaṁ samīkṣyaiva harayo 'dya pravidrutāḥ ।kathamenaṁ raṇe kruddhaṁ vārayiṣyanti vānarāḥ ।। 6.61.32 ॥

translations.english: "On merely seeing Kumbhakarna, the monkeys are running away. How will they check him who is enraged in war?"
